description: Move a link to the archive. It keeps working and keeps its stats; it is only hidden from the main list. Restore it with restore_link.

code.description: The link's code (the part after siz.la/) or its full short address. Give either id or code.

id.description: The link's id, as returned by list_links or shorten_link. Give either id or code.

name: archive_link
title: Archive a link
